lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: You served under the third garrison, didn't you?

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Until there was no garrison left to serve.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: You follow orders even when you know they're wrong.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I follow orders until I can stop the person giving them.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: The Emberguard would take you back, if you asked.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I know. That's why I said it.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: When the ash clears, what's left of the Emberguard?

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: You haven't asked about Vareth's Ridge.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: There's nothing to ask. I know what happened.
